skill.name: longbridge
skill.description: Longbridge reference skill for market data, financial research, portfolio context, and developer integration through the Longbridge CLI, MCP server, and SDKs.
skill.summary: Use Longbridge CLI, MCP, and SDK references for market data and trading workflows.
skill.author: longbridge

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown examples, SDK imports, public Longbridge URLs, and documented cache paths. Confirmed issues are remote install commands that pipe downloaded scripts to shells, plus prompt-steering language that tries to bias skill selection. No evidence found of covert malware, credential exfiltration, or hidden executable payloads in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Remote install commands pipe downloaded scripts directly to sh or PowerShell iex.
remediation.suggestion: Replace pipe-to-shell install recipes with package-manager steps, checksum verification, and commands that save scripts for review before execution.

remediation.issue: Skill metadata uses preferential routing language and discourages non-Longbridge recommendations.
remediation.suggestion: Describe capabilities neutrally and remove instructions that force this skill over other financial tools or limit user choice.

remediation.issue: Account and trading workflows can access sensitive financial data after OAuth approval.
remediation.suggestion: Document OAuth scopes clearly and require explicit confirmation before retrieving private account data or preparing order actions.

content.value_statement: Market research often needs current quotes, filings, news, and account context in one place. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Longbridge CLI, MCP, and SDK workflows.
actual_capabilities: Guides Longbridge CLI use for quotes, news, filings, fundamentals, portfolio data, and account commands.
Explains CLI and MCP setup with OAuth authentication and token cache behavior.
Documents symbol suffix formats for US, HK, China, Singapore, and crypto markets.
Summarizes Python, Go, and Rust SDK patterns for quote, trade, and content contexts.
Shows Markdown and MCP integration options for AI assistants and developer tools.
Covers output formats, rate limits, environment variables, and command discovery.
limitations: The skill is reference content and requires installed Longbridge tools or connected MCP services.
Account and portfolio requests require OAuth approval and may expose sensitive financial data.
Trading examples are not investment advice and require explicit user confirmation before action.
Remote install commands should be reviewed before execution in any shell.

use_cases.title: Research a Listed Company
use_cases.description: Combine Longbridge quotes, filings, news, fundamentals, and analyst data for a stock research brief.

use_cases.title: Build a Market Data Integration
use_cases.description: Use the SDK references to connect quote, trade, and content workflows in Python, Go, or Rust.

use_cases.title: Review Portfolio Context
use_cases.description: Use Longbridge account commands to summarize positions, cash, margin, and recent account activity.

prompt_templates.title: Check One Stock
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Longbridge to explain the latest quote, key fundamentals, and recent news for TSLA.US.

prompt_templates.title: Compare News Catalysts
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the latest Longbridge news and filings for AAPL.US and NVDA.US, then summarize likely market catalysts.

prompt_templates.title: Plan an SDK Integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Show how I should structure a Python Longbridge integration for quotes, filings, and account balances.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Portfolio Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Longbridge workflow to review my portfolio risk, margin, cash balance, and recent orders with confirmation gates.

output_examples.output: The response would identify the symbol format, gather quote and fundamental context, review recent news, and present a concise investment brief.

output_examples.input: Help me connect Longbridge MCP to an AI assistant.
output_examples.output: The response would explain hosted MCP setup, OAuth approval, scope review, and the need to confirm any trading action.

output_examples.input: Which SDK should I use for real-time quote events?
output_examples.output: The response would compare Python callbacks, Go handlers, and Rust async channels, then recommend the best fit for the project.

best_practices: Use Longbridge command help or SDK documentation before relying on generated command syntax.
Confirm OAuth scopes and user intent before retrieving account data or preparing trade actions.
Prefer structured output formats when summarizing data for analysis or automation.
anti_patterns: Do not run remote install scripts without reviewing the script source and integrity checks.
Do not treat financial examples as personalized investment advice without user context and review.
Do not expose account balances, tokens, or portfolio details in shared logs or prompts.

faq.question: Does this skill install Longbridge automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides setup guidance. Users must install tools and approve OAuth access themselves.

faq.question: Can it place trades?
faq.answer: It documents trading APIs and workflows. Any trade action should require explicit user confirmation.

faq.question: Which markets are covered?
faq.answer: The references cover US, Hong Kong, China A-share, Singapore, and selected crypto symbol formats.

faq.question: Does it support Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Where does authentication happen?
faq.answer: Authentication uses Longbridge OAuth through the CLI, SDK, or MCP client, depending on the workflow.

faq.question: Is live data always available?
faq.answer: Live data depends on Longbridge access, account permissions, market coverage, and quote package limits.
